base_winter.description: Demo flight. A321 -> A320, winter evening, no buffer.
base_winter.expect: SAFE. Auto parts moved FWD -> AFT (1 move). No cargo bumped. 2 connecting bags at risk.

summer.expect: SAFE. More weight margin than winter.

summer_buffer.expect: SAFE. Still fits under MZFW, nothing bumped.

winter_buffer.expect: SAFE. Over MZFW without action -> E-commerce pallet (priority 5) bumped.

lightning.description: Winter + 5% buffer + lightning mode (fewest moves ranked above cargo).
lightning.expect: SAFE. Furniture parts (on dock, priority 4) bumped instead of offloading the loaded pallet: fewer moves, different cargo trade-off.

wrong_count.description: DCS passenger count doesn't match the cabin.
wrong_count.expect: BLOCKED. DCS says 161 passengers, cabin has 162.

unsafe.description: Heavier A320ceo variant (extra galley/equipment). Empty plane + passengers alone exceed MZFW.
unsafe.expect: UNSAFE. Even with every bag and all cargo offloaded, zero-fuel weight is over the A320 max.
